title: Argentinian Beef Stew
description: A hearty stew featuring tender beef and a rich, flavorful broth, inspired by the traditions of Argentine cuisine.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine, beef broth, thyme, and paprika to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and cover.
Transfer the pot to the oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
